name: Profound
summary: Platform that monitors brand visibility in AI answer engines and runs marketing agents.
description: Profound tracks what customers ask AI assistants and how brands appear in their answers, with answer engine insights, prompt volumes and shopping and agent analytics. It also deploys AI marketing agents and measures results in a shared workbench. The pricing page did not render during this check, so no price was recorded. Resources include an AEO guide, the Profound Index and a research hub.

pricing.label: Premium
pricing.note: The official pricing page lists a free 7-day trial, with 50 prompts a day, and paid Enterprise and Agency Growth plans. No dollar price was shown.
